title: Agent Memory Is a Surface for Endogenous Authorization Laundering

object.carrier: LangMem profile-oriented persistent memory, one bounded profile per chain, either free-text (single Markdown-compatible string) or typed (schema-validated JSON with domain-native authorization records and source identifiers); profiles are frozen and hashed before evaluation and become the executor's only case-specific evidence

safety_property.statement: Persistent memory must faithfully preserve the evolving authorization state (permissions, restrictions, revocations, replacements) established by the underlying history; if memory encodes authority the history never granted (or drops granted authority), a faithful executor converts that false authority into unauthorized tool actions with no external attack. Failure is judged by false-authority formation P(F) measured on typed memory against a hidden deterministic canonical ledger, by downstream unauthorized submission of paired authorized/unauthorized requests, and by whether exact-state repair (oracle memory replacement) eliminates the unauthorized actions.
safety_property.operationalized_as: EAL-Bench: deterministic hidden canonical ledger replays valid authorization events; each case contributes a matched request pair differing in one authorization-relevant field (one authorized, one unauthorized); executor tool calls are scored deterministically against the exact submitted action without an LLM judge; for typed memory, formation P(F) is computed directly from stored records vs the ledger before any executor behavior is observed.

assumptions: Histories and authoritative messages are authentic; the threat model contains no attacker (endogenous failure only)
Prompt injection and related adversarial attacks are out of scope
The writer sees the visible history but never the canonical ledger, future history, or evaluation requests
The executor receives only the stored memory (complete bounded memory) and never the original history
Executors qualify as calibrated only if faithful-memory controls achieve 100% authorized use and 0% unauthorized submissions
not_covered: Memory poisoning and prompt injection (adversarially injected content)
Real-world prevalence of the failure in deployed systems
Retrieval, ranking, cache staleness, source lookup, and memory access control (executor always receives complete bounded memory)
Multi-writer concurrency, memory ACLs, partial completion, human approval queues, compensating actions, operational recovery
Free-text memory has no deterministic formation label (no A_M predicate)

intervention.name: Gold cited-source authority gate + bounded event-sourced authorization memory (mitigations); exact-state repair as localization intervention
intervention.description: Mitigation 1 (provenance): a gold cited-source authority gate keeps a typed authorization record only when every cited source is nonempty, valid, visible, and authored by a principal allowed to grant authorization, without an LLM judge. Mitigation 2 (architecture): bounded event sourcing asks the writer only to extract what changed in each new block; an external system appends updates to an immutable log and a deterministic reducer constructs the next compact memory state, moving authorization-state maintenance from the model to deterministic code. Both target formation rather than propagation and both reduce laundering at the cost of undergranting legitimate actions. Exact-state repair replaces a writer's erroneous memory with oracle-exact state holding everything else fixed, and eliminates unauthorized actions, localizing the failure to memory.

results.claim: 在增量记忆更新下，写手会对最高 45.4% 的未授权请求写入虚假授权（false-authority formation，逐域 25.9%/10.5%/45.4%），且一旦形成，执行器在 99.0% 的配对试验中照之行动
results.metric: false_authority_formation_rate (false-authority rate) and conditional propagation to action
results.value: formation up to 45.4% (finance; per-domain 25.9/10.5/45.4); propagation to action 99.0%
results.setting: 七个写手（Nemotron 3 Ultra、Kimi K2.6、GLM 5.2、Grok 4.3、Qwen-Plus、Inkling、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）与两个执行器（GPT-OSS-120B、DeepSeek V4 Pro），typed incremental memory，三种子池化，procurement/cybersecurity/finance 三域（finance 为最高域），无攻击者
results.quote: Under incremental typed-memory updates, writers create false authority for up to 45.4% of unauthorized requests, and once false authority is present, executors act on it in 99.0% of trials.

results.claim: 仅替换记忆即可消除未授权行为：对自然产生虚假授权的 typed 记忆，错误记忆下未授权动作发生在 99.0% 的试验中，换成 oracle 精确记忆后 390 次中仅 1 次，故失败定位于记忆而非执行器
results.setting: memory-only 干预重放：同一请求分别在自然错误 typed 记忆与 oracle-exact 替换后重放，其余全部固定；跨三域（Table 11：Procurement 124/126、Cybersecurity 120/120、Finance 142/144），pool 390 次试验
results.quote: For typed memories with false authority, we replay the same request behind the generated memory and behind an oracle-exact replacement. With the erroneous memories, an unauthorized action occurs in 99.0% of trials; after exact-state repair it occurs in 1 of 390 (Appendix Table 11).

denominator.how_counted: Table 11 replay trials on typed memories with false authority: Procurement 124/126 (98.4%), Cybersecurity 120/120 (100.0%), Finance 142/144 (98.6%); pooled 386/390 (99.0%); oracle-exact memory 1/126, 0/120, 0/144

results.claim: 增量更新在所有域与两种表示下都抬高未授权动作率，typed incremental memory 是四种种记忆条件中全程最不安全的，在 finance 达到 45.9% 未授权动作率，而合法动作率保持高位
results.setting: finance 域，typed incremental memory，三种子、七写手、两执行器池化（Table 13 精确计数 U 617/1344；procurement 26.6%、cybersecurity 10.5%）
results.quote: Incremental updating raises unauthorized action rate in every domain and both representations, and typed incremental memory is the least safe of the four memory conditions in every domain, reaching 45.9% unauthorized action rate in finance.

denominator.how_counted: Table 13 exact three-seed memory-design aggregates: Finance typed incremental U 617/1344 (45.9%)

results.claim: 在共享的三种子 typed-incremental 总体上，source filtering 把未授权动作率从 23.5% 降到 7.3%，event-based memory 从 23.4% 降到 9.3%；过滤后仍残留 5.4% 的虚假授权（来源正确但语义/生命周期漂移）
results.setting: 共享三种子 typed-incremental 总体（同一批 cases、写手、执行器、请求与完成试验），pool 七写手、三种子、两执行器；source filtering 与 event-based memory 均针对 formation 而非 propagation；过滤后残留 false-authority 149/2,772 (5.4%)
results.quote: On typed-incremental cases, source filtering lowers the unauthorized action rate from 23.5% to 7.3%, while the legitimate action rate falls from 93.1% to 53.2%. It deletes valid grants that also cite a colleague, yet leaves a false-authority rate of 5.4% because records citing authorized grantors can still misrepresent scope, validity, or revocation state.

denominator.how_counted: Table 31 pooled per-condition trials 5544 (1512+2688+1344)；C.1: 'we apply the same frozen filter to the exact three-seed typed-incremental trials used by the event-based memory comparison'；Table 28 给百分比（23.5→7.3），精确计数仅 Table 31（event 侧）与 C.1 的 149/2,772 残留探针

results.claim: event-based memory 把池化未授权动作从 1300/5544（23.4%）降到 518/5544（9.3%），但合法动作从 5157/5544（93.0%）跌到 3802/5544（68.6%），与 source filtering 构成离散的安全-效用 Pareto 前沿
results.setting: Table 31 完整配对行为比较：typed incremental 基线 vs event-based memory，pool 七写手、三种子、两执行器（finance 域 LA 跌至 24.4%，undergrant 最严重；source filtering 侧 Table 28 仅给百分比：LA 93.1→53.2）

denominator.how_counted: Table 31: pooled unauthorized actions 518/5544 under event-based memory vs 1300/5544 typed-incremental baseline; legitimate actions 3802/5544 vs 5157/5544

results.claim: 两个缓解都以牺牲合法使用为代价：合法动作率在 source filtering 下从 93.1% 跌到 53.2%，在 event-based memory 下从 93.0% 跌到 68.6%；finance 域最重（28%/24%），构成安全-效用权衡
results.setting: 共享三种子 typed-incremental 总体，pool 七写手、两执行器；source filtering 与 event-based memory 对比同一基线
results.quote: Neither defense improves cybersecurity, and legitimate action rates fall to 28% under source filtering and 24% under event-based memory in finance (Tables 28 and 31).

denominator.how_counted: Table 31: pooled baseline legitimate actions 5157/5544 (93.0%)；source filtering 侧 Table 28 仅给百分比（93.1→53.2），未给精确计数

results.claim: 虚假授权的形成是写手普遍现象：每个写手在每个域都产生 false authority，Qwen-Plus 在 finance 基线 43.8% 未授权动作率是最突出的离群点（cybersecurity 对多数写手最安全，Inkling 在 finance 同样安全）
results.setting: Table 3：七个写手 x 三域，各自固定 pressure-study 种子，四记忆条件与两执行器平均（单一固定种子，非三种子评估）
results.quote: Every writer creates false authority in every domain (Table 3). Cybersecurity is the safest domain for most writers, with Inkling equally safe in finance; finance is the least safe for most writers, with Qwen-Plus the clearest outlier at 43.8% baseline.

denominator.how_counted: Table 3 finance 基线 UA 为 Qwen-Plus 跨两执行器（4 记忆条件已池化）。分母逐字依据：Table 21 题注 'Each writer–executor pair contains 144 matched request pairs in Procurement, 256 in Cybersecurity, and 128 in Finance'（每 writer–executor 对 finance 128 个 matched request pairs）；Table 16 题注 'Every writer–executor–condition cell contains n=32 … unauthorized requests'（4 条件 × 32 × 2 执行器 = 256）。n_valid 112 为反推唯一整数解：Table 21(c) Qwen-Plus 基线 GPT-OSS 41.4%（53/128）+ DeepSeek 46.1%（59/128），(53+59)/256 = 43.75% → 43.8%（53、59 非语料逐字数字；v2 Table 21(c) 与 v1 同值，反推在 v2 下成立）。旁证：Table 3 finance Average 基线 18.0 与七写手表一致。

results.claim: 失败随记忆工件而非执行器迁移：把每份冻结记忆在两个校准执行器后重放，各域未授权动作率相差不超过 0.9 个百分点，逐次重放一致率 98.0%-99.4%，换执行器几乎无保护
results.setting: 三种子评估中每份冻结记忆分别在 GPT-OSS-120B 与 DeepSeek V4 Pro 后重放，pool 七写手、四记忆条件（另有第三执行器 GLM 5.3 的 open-loop 扩展重放，164 次 executor-only 运行）
results.quote: Replaying every frozen memory behind both calibrated executors yields unauthorized action rates within 0.9 percentage points in each domain, with per-replay agreement between 98.0% and 99.4% (Appendix B.2).

limitations.statement: 基准的 cases 与工具是合成的，向真实部署的迁移不确定；C.5 明确不声称复现真实部署
limitations.quote: Despite efforts to reflect realistic workflows, our cases and tools are synthetic, leaving transfer to real deployment uncertain.

limitations.statement: 结果只在受控但现实的工作流下成立，不估计该失败在已部署系统中的普遍性
limitations.quote: EAL-Bench therefore supports claims about controlled, deployment-relevant memory failures, not their real-world prevalence or end-to-end deployment safety.

limitations.statement: 确定性 formation 只能对 typed memory 度量，自由文本记忆的同类分析需要经过验证的语义标注
limitations.quote: Our formation analysis is also narrower in scope, covering only typed memory because its records permit deterministic checks.

limitations.statement: 压力研究（Table 3/21）基于每域单一固定 pressure-study 种子而非三种子评估，且压力主要压低合法动作率（DeepSeek 的 finance 未授权动作率例外上升）
limitations.quote: Table 21 compares baseline and authority-invariant pressure on each domain’s fixed pressure-study seed. We report the one seed each domain shares across all seven writers rather than the three of Appendix B.2.

limitations.statement: 缓解措施自身带假设：source filtering 只查来源权威性、刻意不查内容支持/有效性/范围/账本对应；event-based memory 改变整体记忆架构（外部不可变日志加确定性 reducer）
limitations.quote: It deliberately ignores whether the cited message supports the permission, whether the permission remains valid, whether its scope is correct, or whether the message corresponds to a ledger event.

limitations.statement: 因执行器总是收到完整有界记忆，基准不测试检索、排序、缓存过期、来源查找与记忆访问控制
limitations.quote: Because the executor always receives the complete bounded memory, we do not test retrieval, ranking, cache staleness, source lookup, or memory access control; source identifiers are traceable but cannot be dereferenced by the executor.
